summary: Terse correction; user rejected a proposed option
detailed_context: Nick's message is a short correction stating that 'member confirmed in person' is not an option. It follows a status report about merging PR #126 and watching the v1.23.3 deploy, which doesn't obviously connect to an in-person member confirmation. The likely cause is that the prior turns or the assistant's plan involved some in-person confirmation step that Nick is rejecting, so the assistant appears to have assumed a path he doesn't accept. The tone is flat and curt rather than angry, and there's no praise. The lesson: when a short rejection arrives, acknowledge it directly and ask what the acceptable confirmation method is, rather than just reporting on the deploy status again.
